summary: Completed Module 01 BUILD: Diagnosed and resolved Bug #1 (Env var mismatch) and Bug #2 (Pagination boundary & sorting)
evidence: Created progress/module-01-diagnosis.md documenting hypotheses, observations, fixes, and verification proofs
Verified LinkOps infrastructure: infra/docker-compose.yml, worker/main.py, scripts/seed.py, apps/api/app/routers/admin.py
Diagnosed Bug #1: DB_URL in .env mismatched DATABASE_URL in config, resulting in empty DB URL crash; fixed by standardizing to DATABASE_URL
Diagnosed Bug #2: Off-by-one pagination (offset = page * limit) skipped first 10 items; missing ORDER BY caused unstable ordering
Fixed Bug #2: Implemented offset = (page - 1) * limit with deterministic order_by(Link.id.asc())
Seeded 25 test links and verified across page=1 (test01-test10), page=2 (test11-test20), and page=3 (test21-test25): exactly 25/25 unique items
